headline: Nigerian President Tinubu Pledges Upgrades for Ibom Deep Seaport and Airport
summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu announced federal commitment to upgrade the Ibom Deep Seaport and international airport in Akwa Ibom State following requests from local leadership.
why: Infrastructure investments in deep-water ports and transportation hubs drive trade volume and regional economic development in West Africa.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Federal port and airport upgrades enhance transportation logistics and regional trade activity.
